input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship 5 (einvoice-preflight): Spanish Facturae 3.2.1/3.2.2 reader; Spanish NIE/KLM NIF false-reject fix
errors: First fixture had wrong batch totals (TotalInvoicesAmount set to the executable amount); the new checker flagged it (ES-004/005) and the fixture was corrected.
Schema builder first ignored minOccurs=0 on xs:choice (AccountType), giving a false ES-020 with an empty message; fixed before the eval.
A background command using a trailing & was killed; reran with run_in_background.

doc_friction.issue: einvoice-preflight next: sat at 1965/2000 chars, so adding a landed item meant cutting another; flagship_field.py's suggested trims were useful but a multi --replace whose OLD strings partly failed to match reported only the over-length total, not which OLD was not found.
The flagship row's open items all need outside inputs; picking a buildable slice (a new national format) meant reading the venture for gaps rather than following the row.

deviations.why: Every listed einvoice-preflight item needs a real outside file or a blocked host, so I built an unlisted gap (no Facturae support, though Spain's B2G format and a B2B option) instead of adding inputs_only.
deviations.did: Facturae 3.2.1/3.2.2 reader from the official XSDs and field description, measured against xmllint.
deviations.result: Landed with 0 false rejects on 1,000 files and full agreement with xmllint on 6,539 structural mutants.

goal: Deepen a flagship with a hard engineering slice: a new national e-invoice format checked against primary sources.
notes: Sources: facturae.gob.es XSDs 3.2.1/3.2.2 (sha256 pinned) and Esquema castellano v3.2.x (06/06/2017), both downloaded in-session. Eval: node eval/facturae-differential.mjs (two seeds x 500): 1000/1000 xmllint-valid, 0 false rejects; 6539/6539 structural verdicts equal xmllint's; 5006/5006 arithmetic mutants caught. Generator and checker share one reading of the field description (arithmetic not independently confirmed); no real business Facturae file. NIE/KLM fix: 891 -> 55 disagreements with python-stdnum 2.2 on 6000 numbers (remaining 55 = stricter CIF control form, kept). run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight: ok (12.7 s, JS + Python, 106 tests skipped needing npm deps).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: XSD-to-table builder, a ~35-rule reader from a Spanish spec, a seeded generator + xmllint differential, and an ID-check fix: about three days for a mid-level engineer who knows e-invoicing

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
